def bars_runs(inp,bcol):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    hb=[];vb=[]
    for i in range(h):
        j=0
        while j<w:
            if inp[i][j]==bcol:
                k=j
                while k<w and inp[i][k]==bcol: k+=1
                if k-j>=2: hb.append((i,j,k-1)); j=k
                else: j+=1
            else: j+=1
    for j in range(w):
        i=0
        while i<h:
            if inp[i][j]==bcol:
                k=i
                while k<h and inp[k][j]==bcol: k+=1
                if k-i>=2: vb.append((j,i,k-1)); i=k
                else: i+=1
            else: i+=1
    return hb,vb

def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pos=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if inp[i][j]!=bg: pos[inp[i][j]].append((i,j))
    def maxrun(c):
        best=0
        for row in inp:
            run=0
            for v in row:
                if v==c: run+=1
                else: best=max(best,run); run=0
            best=max(best,run)
        for col in range(w):
            run=0
            for r in range(h):
                if inp[r][col]==c: run+=1
                else: best=max(best,run); run=0
            best=max(best,run)
        return best
    bcol=max(pos,key=lambda c:maxrun(c))
    barcells=[(i,j) for c in pos if c!=bcol for i,j in pos[c]]
    pos[bcol]=barcells
    fill=max(set(map(lambda l:l[0],pos.values()))-[bcol])
    hb,vb=bars_runs(inp,bcol)
    assert len(hb)==1 or len(vb)==1,'two parallel pairs unclear'
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    # pick the pair perpendicular to rays: markers define direction of ray (horizontal marker => vertical ray down)
    mks=[p for c in pos if c!=bcol for p in pos[c]]
    if any(m[1]!=m[1] for m in mks): pass
    # horizontal markers -> vertical ray from top bar downward
    if len(hb)==1:
        ti,tj,_=hb[0]
        vi_,vjo,_=vb[0]
        mk=mks[0]
        offs=set()
        s=vi_  # offset along span = distance from other bar start? use marker col offsets
        if mk[1]>tj: ddir=mk[1]-tj
        elif mk[1]<tj: ddir=tk_mj_tj
        offss=sorted({m[1]-d for m in mks})
        print('offs',offss,'bars',hb,vb,'marker',mks)
        for j0 in offss:
            jj=tj+ddir+j0
            ii=ti+1
            while 0<=ii<h:
                if inp[ii][jj]==bcol: break
                out[ii][jj]=fill
                ii+=1
    for i,j in pos[list(pos)-{bcol}]: pass
    for c in pos:
        if c!=bcol:
            for i,j in pos[c]: out[i][j]=4
    return out

import numpy as np
def solve(inp):
    inp=np.array(inp); bg=Counter(inp.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bars=[]; mk=[]
    for v in Counter(inp.flatten()):
        if v==bg: continue
        pos=[(i,j) for i in range(inp.shape[0]) for j in range(inp.shape[1]) if inp[i,j]==v]
        if len(pos)<=6: mk.append((v,pos))
        else: bars.append((v,pos))
    out=inp.copy()
    for v,p in mk: out[tuple(p)]=4
    # find bars: two non-bg colors
    colors=sorted(Counter(inp.flatten()).items())
    # bar color = most common non-bg
    cnt=Counter(inp.flatten()); del cnt[bg]
    bcol=max(cnt.items(), key=lambda x:x[1])[0]
    mcols=set(cnt)-{bg,bcol}
    # markers: cells whose color in mcols, plus any extra? use all cells not bg & not part of bar runs
    bpos=[(i,j) for i in range(inp.shape[0]) for j in range(inp.shape[1]) if inp[i,j]==bcol]
    # marker cells = remaining non-bg
    out[:,out!=bg]=np.where(np.isin(out,(bcol,) or set(mcols)), out, out)
    return out,bg,bcol,mk

def solve(inp):
    inp=np.array(inp); h,w=inp.shape
    cnt=Counter(inp.flatten()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    comps=[]; rem=set((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i,j]!=bg)
    while rem:
        c=rem.pop(); q=deque([c]); comp=[c]
        while q:
            x=q.popleft()
            for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                y=(x[0]+dx,x[1]+dy)
                if y in rem: rem.remove(y); q.append(y); comp.append(y)
        comps.append(comp)
    comps.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    bcol=inp[comps[0][0],comps[0][1]]
    segs=[sorted(c) for c in comps if inp[c[0][0],c[0][1]]==bcol]
    assert len(segs)==2, comps
    out=inp.copy()
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if inp[i,j] not in (bg,bcol): out[i,j]=4
    # horizontal bars -> vertical rays; vertical bars -> horizontal rays
    def is_horiz(seg): return seg[0][0]==seg[-1][0]
    if is_horiz(segs[0]):
        rA,cA,sA=segs[0][0]; rB,cB,sB=segs[1][0]
        top,rA_,cA_,L_=rA,cA,len(segs[0])
        bot,rB_,cB_,LB=rB,cB,len(segs[1])
        # fill columns of each bar vertically toward other bar, excluding columns occupied by markers? no — demo6 fills ALL columns of both bars' spans except where marker blocks
        for (r,c,L) in [(top,cA,L_),(bot,cB,LB)]:
            lo,hi=min(r,c),max(r,c)
            rng=range(lo+1,hi-1) if rA<rB else range(r-rng_len,0)  # placeholder
            rng=range(min(r,c)+1,max(r,c))
            for i in rng:
                if inp[i,c]==bg:
                    out[i,c]=9  # fill color = ? derive below
    return out

def info(n):
    ai=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); ao=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    H,W=ai.shape
    cnt=Counter(map(int,ai.flatten())); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bars=[]
    # top bar: nonzero row0 cells forming segment; bottom bar: nonzero last-row cells
    def seg(cells): return Counter(cells).most_common()[:1]
    top=[c for c in range(W) if ai[0,c]!=bgc]
    bot=[c for c in range(W) if ai[-1,c]!=bgc]
    topseg=[ai[0,c] for c in top]; botseg=[ai[-1,c] for c in bot]

def analyze(k):
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=comps_of(gi,bg)
    bars=[c for c,cs in comps if len(cs)>=2]; marks=[(c,cs[0]) for c,cs in comps if len(cs)==1]
    # assume exactly 2 bars, horizontal; top bar first bar (min row), bottom last
    tb=min(bars,key=lambda b:min(r for r,_ in b[1])); bb=max(bars,key=lambda b:max(r for r,_ in b[1]))
    tcol=tb[0]; bcol=bb[0]
    tcells=set(tb[1]); bcells=set(bb[1])
    print('==',k,'bg',bg,'topbar color',tcol,'botbar',bcol,'nmarks',len(marks))
    for col,(r,c) in marks:
        # find columns in output where this color added, rows extent
        ch=[(rr,cc,vv) for rr in range(H) for cc in range(W) if gi[rr][cc]==bg and go[rr][cc]==col]
        cols=sorted(set(cc for _,cc,_ in ch)); rows=sorted(set(rr for rr,_,_ in ch))
        print(' marker',(r,c),'added color',col,'cols',cols,'rows',rows)
    # also check what happened to marker cells
    for col,(r,c) in marks:
        print('   marker cell',col,(r,c)->G[k+' output'][r][c])

# Write a clean solver with search over mirror-offset sign and cap mode, validate on all demos.
def solve(gi, go=None):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=components(gi,bg)
    bars=[o for o in objs if len(o[1])>=2]
    mc=[o[1][0] for o in objs if len(o[1])==1]
    bi=[(min(y for y,_ in cs),max(y for y,_ in cs),min(x for _,x in cs),max(x for _,x in cs)) for _,cs in bars]
    top=min(bi,key=lambda b:b[0]); bot=max(bi,key=lambda b:b[0])
    trow,tomax,trl,trr=top; brow,bomax,brl,brr=bot
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    horiz = abs(trow-brow) > max(trr-trl, brr-brl)
    return dict(bg=bg,mk=mc,top=top,bot=bot,horiz=horiz,H=H,W=W,
                trow=trow,tomax=tomax,trl=trl,trr=trr,brow=brow,bomax=bomax,brl=brl,brr=brr)

def bars_and_markers(i):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%i]
